title: Switching audio or subtitles mid-film is quick and never costs the picture
description: Serves PRODUCT.md: "Changing audio or subtitles mid-film is quick, doesn't restart the picture, and never costs picture quality." Today each audio track is made with its own picture, and a subtitle drawn into the picture forces a re-encode.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing the audio track mid-film takes moments and doesn't restart or re-make the picture.
Choosing a subtitle never lowers the picture's quality or turns a film sent as it is into a re-encode, on any of Octave's players.
The design states what this costs in storage and CPU.
notes: Coarse: sharpened when stage 3 is planned in detail.
